name: quests
description: A gamification layer that turns your goals and habits into quests, awards XP for completing them, and tracks your level and achievements.
author: kirocrew
highlights: Turns goals and habits into themed quests with objectives
Awards XP for completing quests and tracks a level/title progression
Unlocks achievements as you hit milestones
Single-user, local-first: all state lives under the app data dir
